title: Hormone Replacement Therapy in Ocala, FL | GLO Aesthetics
meta: Hormone replacement therapy in Ocala, FL for low testosterone, menopause and thyroid symptoms, based on labs, from $200/month. Book a free consultation.
answer: Hormone replacement therapy is a physician-supervised treatment that restores hormones such as testosterone, estrogen, progesterone or thyroid hormone when lab work shows they're low and causing symptoms. It suits men with confirmed low testosterone and women with menopause symptoms. It's an ongoing program with no downtime; many people feel better in 2–4 weeks, with fuller effects over 3–6 months.
treats_h2: What does hormone replacement therapy treat?
treats_intro: Hormone replacement therapy treats symptoms of hormone imbalance — low testosterone and libido, menopause symptoms like hot flashes and poor sleep, thyroid-related fatigue, and low energy or brain fog.
how_h2: How does hormone replacement therapy work?
how: Hormones act as chemical messengers that affect energy, mood, sleep, libido and metabolism. When levels drop — with age, menopause or thyroid problems — symptoms can follow. GLO starts with comprehensive labs to confirm your levels are low and symptomatic. Your provider then prescribes testosterone, bioidentical hormones or thyroid support as an injectable, topical or pellet, and uses follow-up labs at 3, 6 and 12 months to keep your levels in a healthy range.
fit_h2: Is hormone replacement therapy right for me?
good_fit: You're a man with low energy, low libido or other symptoms and labs confirming low testosterone
You're a woman with hot flashes, poor sleep or mood changes around menopause
You have fatigue, weight gain or brain fog and want your thyroid checked
You want a personalized plan with regular lab monitoring
not_fit: You're pregnant, breastfeeding or trying to conceive
You have a history of hormone-sensitive cancer such as breast or prostate cancer
You've had blood clots, stroke or certain heart conditions — your provider will review your risks
Your main goal is weight loss — functional weight loss may be the better fit
expect_h2: What happens when you start hormone replacement therapy?
expect_intro: You start with comprehensive labs and a consultation, then receive a personalized protocol. Follow-up labs at 3, 6 and 12 months guide adjustments as your levels and symptoms change.

faq_add.q: What are the side effects of hormone replacement therapy?
faq_add.a: Side effects depend on the hormone and dose and may include acne, fluid retention, breast tenderness or mood changes. Testosterone can raise red blood cell counts, which is one reason we monitor your labs regularly and adjust your protocol.

faq_add.q: Injections, creams or pellets: which is best for hormone therapy?
faq_add.a: There's no single best option. Injections, topicals and pellets each differ in convenience and how steady your levels stay. Your provider will recommend a delivery method based on your labs, lifestyle and goals.

faq_add.q: How long do I need to stay on hormone replacement therapy?
faq_add.a: It varies. Some people use hormone therapy for a defined period, such as through menopause symptoms, while others continue longer. Your provider will review your symptoms and labs over time and adjust or step down your protocol as needed.
